summary: Frontend-only verification of the award-level polish pass (Lenis smooth scroll, kinetic Hero with masked reveal + Hero3D photo centerpiece, Marquee, Manifesto, Projects, About, Contact, Drone). All 12 requested feature areas pass on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). No JS console errors, no page errors, and zero broken images across the entire page (hero, project covers, all 6 flagship modal images, all 8 drone photos).
critical_code_review_comments: PROFILE.linkedin still points at the LinkedIn root ('https://www.linkedin.com/') rather than Carlos's specific profile — pre-existing content nit carried over from iteration_3.

Hero3D fallback img uses object-cover object-center on a fixed 520px container with a 900x1600 portrait source — visually acceptable (subject is centered) but the top/bottom of the portrait is cropped. Non-blocking.

link-file has href='#resume' with no target and preventDefault in handler — works correctly (URL unchanged, sonner toast shown) but href='#resume' briefly nudges history when JS is disabled; consider href='#' or role=button. Non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lenis smooth-scroll notes: window.__lenis is exposed; use window.__lenis.scrollTo(el, {immediate:true}) for instant jumps in tests. Nav clicks work but require ~1200-1500ms settle. modal-scrim close works with page.mouse.click(10, 10). Escape close needs window.focus() first + ~1s for exit animation. Modal inner-panel is the scroll container (scrollHeight ~6258 / clientHeight ~970 on 1920x1080). All 4 project cards open the modal. hero-featured-chip also opens the flagship modal. All 5 real /projects/*.jpg photos load (naturalWidth 900 or 1200). Marquee overflow-x is contained inside overflow-hidden — no body horizontal overflow on 390x844.

detailed_verifications.hero: hero-view-work-btn, hero-contact-btn, hero-centerpiece (img src=/projects/cobot-holder.jpg naturalWidth=900 naturalHeight=1600), hero-featured-chip all present. Name 'Carlos'/'Sibaja', stroked 'Engineering', PROFILE.positioning and PROFILE.intro paragraphs all render.
detailed_verifications.smooth_scroll: window.__lenis truthy. All 5 nav links (nav-home/projects/about/contact/drone) scroll their sections into view within ~1.2s (top < viewportH*0.6). hero-view-work-btn scrolls to #projects (top=154 inView=true). hero-contact-btn triggers scroll (verified via successful click; nav-contact route independently confirms #contact scrolling works).
detailed_verifications.marquee: data-testid='marquee' present exactly once between hero and manifesto. overflow: hidden; scrollWidth 3482 on 390 viewport (contained).
detailed_verifications.manifesto: #manifesto renders. Contains '01','02','03','04' and titles 'Observe','Design','Prototype','Refine' along with body text.
detailed_verifications.projects: All 4 cards render: project-card-cobot-ultrasonic (flagship), gripper-fixture, faro-fairino-reliability, cad-3d-printing. All 4 open project-modal on click. hero-featured-chip also opens the flagship modal.
detailed_verifications.flagship_modal_images: 6 in modal — cobot-welding (hero), cobot-fixture, cobot-holder, cobot-process, cobot-cad, cobot-welding (final). All naturalWidth 900 or 1200, naturalHeight 1600. Zero broken.
detailed_verifications.modal_close_paths: modal-close-btn closes + body.style.overflow returns to ''. modal-scrim click at (10,10) closes + unlocks. Escape closes + unlocks (after window.focus + ~1s).
detailed_verifications.about_timeline: timeline-item-0 through timeline-item-5 all present (count=1 each).
detailed_verifications.contact_links: link-linkedin (target=_blank, href=https://www.linkedin.com/), link-mail (mailto:Carlossibaja18@gmail.com, target=_blank), link-file (href=#resume, click preserves URL and shows sonner toast 'Resume coming soon'), link-camera (href=#drone; click scrolls #drone into view top=11).
detailed_verifications.drone: drone-photo-0..7 all render, naturalWidth range 3992-8192, all complete=true. drone-photo-0 click opens drone-lightbox; drone-lightbox-close closes it.
detailed_verifications.no_broken_images: Full-page img sweep (before and after modal interactions) — 0 imgs with complete=true and naturalWidth=0.

detailed_verifications.mobile_390x844: documentElement.scrollWidth === window.innerWidth (390) — no horizontal overflow. nav-mobile-toggle opens menu, all 5 nav-mobile-* links present, nav-mobile-projects scrolls #projects into view (top=10.5 inView=true). Hero centerpiece and CTAs stack correctly and are visible.
